title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode5 Hope That Spreads

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Line: A few weeks later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for gathering here today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll begin explaining what this volunteering event is about once everyone's here, so please wait in your seats in the interim.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Okay, we have plenty of printouts...
I'll make sure one last time that I didn't make any mistakes on the blackboard...)

Oh no! Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do?!
Haruka's standing right in front of me...!
Wait, I thought you said that you were prepared mentally for this moment?

B-But...!
Haruka just looks so cool leading everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(...?
They seem to be having a lively conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, did you have a question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Haruka?! I mean, Kiritani...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, umm... No questions!
I'm sorry for being so loud...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
You're from the class next door, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to working with you today, and I promise to do my best for the children!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's do our best together, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
The day of the volunteer session
Children's Center

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When solving multiplication problems on paper, it's important to think about them from different angles.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, let's say that you have three boxes with sixteen manju in each of them. How would you figure out how many manju you have?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Umm... That's too big for my times tables, so do I just have to count them by hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That could also work.
But, what if you thought about them as three boxes of ten manju and three boxes of six...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Oh... Thirty and eighteen make forty-eight!
Now I get it. I need to multiply things first and then add them together. Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Try using that trick for some of these other problems.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Are there any others who need help with their homework...? No, I think they're okay. I should be able to help the other groups now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The picture book and doll teams seem to have enough people... I'll go take a look at playtime in the gym.)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh? Is she crying...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did she fall? Or did she get into an argument with a friend...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In any case, I should go talk to her.)
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! What happened, Miyuki?!
Did you trip and fall?!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
*Cry*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Wh-What should I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh... Uhh... Wait!
That's a Magical☆Ribbon Knights t-shirt, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means you know this song, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line:
...!
That's the song from Ribbon Knights...!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You two are great singers.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Miyuki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?! Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to her, we get to see your beautiful smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to tell us why you were crying just now?

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: So, I went over to see if I could play dodgeball with everyone because it looked like fun...

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: But they told me that I couldn't because I'm bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go with you!
We can ask them to let them join us together!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: No, that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line:
I really am bad at sports.
So, I'll draw instead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have an idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we try giving them a little surprise?
One hour later
Gym

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: Take this!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Where did she learn to throw like this?!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: Yes, I got him...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's game! The white team wins!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: Wow, we won...!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Darn it. You were really good!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was amazing, Miyuki!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
That's because of your guys' special dodgeball training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Our surprise went off without a hitch.

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, I didn't really like sports...
But that might've changed a little today.

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: So, I'll try my best when we play tag and jump rope tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, please do! We'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, let's scramble the teams and play another game!

rows.Speaker: Miyuki
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna play again!
se_run_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me train her, Hanasato. You're a big part of why she's smiling the way she is now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What? N-No...!
I just wanted her to smile and laugh is all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If anything, Haruka... I mean, Kiritani, you were the amazing one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not only did you help her get into that game of dodgeball, you showed her how playing sports can be fun...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You reminded me of how you're an incredible idol who can spread hope to anyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I know you aren't one anymore!
I'm sorry! I didn't mean to blurt that out all of a sudden...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that's who you've always been in my mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You were the person who gave me my dream of becoming an idol...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of becoming an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I was finally able to make my debut last year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm still nowhere near where you were...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I keep replaying what you said...
“Tomorrow will always be a better day.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even when I'm feeling down, I'm able to keep going!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Back then, and even now, you've been a huge source of hope for me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep trying to become an idol that can spread hope to others just like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What I did to Mai and the way I disappointed so many of my fans are both unforgivable.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was able to give someone hope.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm still able to give people the push they need.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? No, you don't need to thank me...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, what you said just gave me hope for a better tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, if you like...
You can just call me Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no need to be formal since we're both in the same year. So, can I call you Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! U-Uhh, yes!
O-Of course... I mean, yeah, that's fine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, Minori, let's do our best during the time we have left here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to keep figuring out what I can do.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to do it when I was an idol, but I want to keep spreading as much hope as I can now.)
I'm sure you will, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did someone just...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Was that my imagination?
But I feel so encouraged now for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to keep moving forward and hold on to these feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Movie
